pokedexEntries.bk: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

pokedexEntries.wh: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.

pokedexEntries.x: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.

pokedexEntries.as: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other’s school.

pokedexEntries.us: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.

pokedexEntries.um: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That's how violent Basculin are.

pokedexEntries.sw: Anglers love the fight this Pokémon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.

pokedexEntries.sh: In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it's more popular with the youth.

pokedexEntries.sc: Its temperament is vicious and aggressive. This Pokémon is also full of vitality and can multiply rapidly before anyone notices.

pokedexEntries.vi: It's so vicious that it's called the Thug of the River. Yet Basculin is still targeted by predators, such as Dondozo and Bombirdier.
